headline: Java4Shell exploitation attempts begin; NGINX2Root PoCs public; Apache Roller and Axis exploited; critical PHP, Drupal, vCenter fixes

bullets.text: Developing, critical: Java4Shell (CVE-2026-114938) is now at 11 outlets and SecurityWeek reports exploitation attempts have begun as vendors rush out advisories. Earlier reports name Jira, Jenkins and Keycloak as exposed.

New, critical: F5 patched the NGINX2Root flaws in NGINX (CVE-2026-123007, CVE-2026-123633) and PoC exploits are public, per SecurityWeek; 7 outlets. Separately, F5 warns 6 critical BIG-IP flaws may allow RCE in specific setups.

Exploited: Apache Roller (CVE-2026-129448) and Apache Axis (CVE-2026-90436) are under attack; Axis entered CISA KEV 11-18 with a due date of 11-21. KEV also added Synology DSM CVE-2024-10441, REDCap CVE-2026-90817 (both due 11-21) and LiteLLM CVE-2026-40217 (due 12-02).

New critical patches: PHP fixed 7 critical flaws including RCE (CVE-2026-115560); Drupal patched a critical installer RCE and warns exploits may surface quickly; VMware vCenter has a CVSS 9.8 auth bypass; Cisco Expressway is exploited soon after a PoC.

Still active: Puppet Enterprise RCE (CVE-2026-115731, KEV due 12-01), ScreenConnect CVE-2026-84869 against MSPs, Optimizely malicious code (7 outlets), and poisoned pip agent-framework 1.26.1/1.26.2. N-able confirmed hackers accessed a cloud server.

Breaches: TfL Oyster data on 265,000 users exposed; payee data at 40 Irish credit unions exposed via a provider; European Commission confirms a cyberattack using an AI tool; NVIDIA investigating Gentlemen ransomware claims. SITCON 3; 7-day score 1.02x the 90-day average.

actions: Inventory Java apps such as Jira, Jenkins and Keycloak; apply vendor fixes for Java4Shell (CVE-2026-114938) now that exploitation attempts are reported.
NGINX users: apply F5's NGINX2Root fixes (CVE-2026-123007, CVE-2026-123633) today; PoCs are public. BIG-IP admins: review the 6 critical flaws.
Patch or isolate Apache Roller and Apache Axis; Axis, Synology DSM and REDCap KEV entries are due 11-21, SonicWall SSLVPN CVE-2026-19868 is due 11-20.
Update PHP for CVE-2026-115560 and the other critical fixes; apply Drupal's installer RCE fix before exploits appear; patch VMware vCenter and Cisco Expressway.
LiteLLM operators: patch CVE-2026-40217 (KEV, due 12-02). Remove pip agent-framework 1.26.1 or 1.26.2 if present and rotate cloud credentials.
N-able customers: watch vendor notices on the cloud server breach and review email security management settings.
